rows.text:
Rabbits have no freedom
As their perspectives always stretch elsewhere
They diverge, they evade
They carve out many a path
Between one another with no return
 
Love becomes extravagance
For it is rich enough
Wisdom becomes miserliness
For it is poor enough
 
Rabbits are not masters of dominance
Nor do they bow to Gods
They decree by their own will
And seize the inversion of strength
 
It is not that cause begets effect
Rather, it is the effect
That sets rabbits searching for a cause
